TCF prompt decks

One deck per TCF answer box: your own sentences, in French, in the order you'd say or write them.

Decks are listed most-listed first (how often the box's prompts were listed), then by coverage. New counts the cards you have not met in an earlier deck of the same task, if you study the decks in list order. Each deck opens on the prompt, the other prompts it also serves (≈ = close variant: same plan, adjust to the question), its coverage, and what is not in your words yet (you'd improvise those parts).

Card front: a literal, French-shaped English line, then your own English (swapped words underlined). Back: the French and the part of the answer it delivers. In a deck, press e to edit a card, Esc when done; u undoes, new / all at the top pick the cards in play. Written decks show the French word count next to the TCF minimum: a statistic, not a target. Progress and edits are per deck and saved in this browser only.
